dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave spline with a deep inward curve along the trailing edge from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded apex with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply inclined margin at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.25:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a moderate radius defining the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick beak structure extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions to the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive mottled pigmentation with irregular light and dark patches along the lateral surface.
